liabilities_or_loans: Proposed for inclusion in Section 22A(1)(B) Prohibitory Properties list under A.P. Registration Act, 1908
summary: This document is an official land record proposal from the Revenue Divisional Officer, Palasa to the District Collector, Srikakulam regarding land in Survey No. 116/8 of Tallabhadra Village, Sompeta Mandal. The subject plot measures 0.67 Acres and is classified as Government Poramboke / Social Welfare Land Acquisition (SWLA) land under the Revenue Department. The proposal requests the inclusion of this government parcel into the prohibitory property list under Section 22A(1)(B) of the A.P. Registration Act, 1908.
full_raw_text:
RDOPLS-LAND0SUR/9/2025-DT(LR)-RDOPLS 1/180245/2025

Rc.No.1258/2025 DT (LR) 16-12-2025 Revenue Divisional Office, Palasa
From To
Sri G.Venkatesh, B.Tech., The District Collector,
Revenue Divisional Officer, Srikakulam.
Palasa Division.
Sir,
Sub:- Purification of 22 A - Inclusions -Srikakulam District - Palasa Division Sompeta Mandal - Tallabhadra Village - Request for inclusion of GOVT. lands in Sy.No.116/8 with an extent of Ac.0.67 in the list of Prohibitory Properties U/s 22 - A (1) (B) of Tallabhadra village - Proposals submitted - Reg.

Ref:- 1) Instructions of the District Collector, Srikakulam during the RO's Conference dt:14.05.2025
2)Rc.No.267/2025 A dt:11.12.2025 of the Tahsildar, Sompeta .
***
Kind attention is invited to the reference cited.

It is submitted that in the reference 1st cited, the District Collector, Srikakulam has directed to verify the 22A Prohibited Properties for identification of the errors and rectifications if any and submit 22-A Prohibited properties proposals for notifying the same.

It is submitted that in the reference 2nd cited, the Tahsildar, Sompeta has submitted a report the Tahsildar, Sompeta has submitted a report stating that the field and Revenue permanent records was got verified and enquired by the gross root level and submitted their report stating that, the Sy.No.116/8 with an extent of Ac.0.67 cents is classified as "Poramboke" Land and recorded as SWLA in SLR and webland and requested to be added in 22 Annexures list of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal, and the same entries were not entered in 22-A (1) (B) respectively.

The Tahsildar, Sompeta has further reported that as verified the report of the Mandal Surveyor, asper the SFA,& Webland of the Tallabhadra Village, the subject land details are as follows:
Sl. No. | Sy.No. | Land Classification as per SFA | Extent in Ac. | Enjoyer Name as per SFA | Pattadar Name as per webland | Extent in Ac.
1 | 116/8 | Poramboke | 0.67 | Government Land | Government Land | 0.65

The Tahsildar, Sompeta also reported that, to add the entries in 22-(1) (B) and IGRS prohibited properties list of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal.
Sl. No. | Name of the Mandal | Name of the Village | Sy.No | Extent in Ac. | Name of the Assigned/Allottee/Owner | Classification
1 | Sompeta | Tallabhadra | 116/8 | 0.67 | Revenue Department | SWLA

The Tahsildar, Sompeta has further reported that, as per the above table 1 & 2 stated that, the above said subject land the Sy.No.116/7 & 8 as per F.M.B of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal converted to SWLA housing colony. However, it has not been entered in Sub Registrar Prohibitory list. The Tahsildar has requested that the SWLA lands be included in Sub Registrar Prohibitory list under A.P. Registration Act, 1908.

Therefore, it is requested that, the above Govt Poramboke land SWLA in Sy.No.116/8 to an extent of Ac.0.67 cents of Tallabhadra Village, Sompeta Mandal kindly be included in Prohibitory property list in Section -22A(1) (B) under A.P. Registration Act, 1908.

The Report of the Tahsildar, Sompeta and its enclosures are submitted herewith for kind perusal.

Encls : As above

Yours faithfully,
GRANDHI VENKATESH
Revenue Divisional Officer,
Palasa Division

Copy to the Tahsildar, Sompeta.
